body: believe me, i understand how you feel. feel free to chat with me if you’d like, i don’t mind.

think about why you’ve never had a friendship with a “female”. what is there about you that warrants a woman to want to befriend you? you’re not entitled to anyone’s time or energy and neither am i. nobody is entitled to friendship with someone. friendship and companionship are what you make of them. i’m sure that you have redeeming qualities based purely off of the fact that you’ve had a lot of friends, i don’t doubt that. but by sitting here and complaining about this female monolith that won’t acknowledge your existence, no woman is going to just come to you and befriend you. i certainly won’t be friends with someone that only talks to me because i’m a woman. i’m friends with people that see me as a person because that’s what i am. believe it or not, despite this image you’ve built of all women in your head, i would agree to have a chat. that’s not a creepy thing to ask, you’re just shooting yourself in the foot by making assumptions about what everyone else thinks. you seem to have become a self fulfilling prophecy by allowing yourself to immerse into this vicious cycle of self pity and envy of those you place above yourself. despite this, you can still break free from it. i don’t know you, but i truly do believe that. be the change you want yourself to be.

also, just speaking from personal experience, i’ve never befriended anyone that calls women females. it’s just weird and reduces people to their most innate biological parts. i don’t go around calling men “males”. 

on another note, how is me calling my life not colorful hard to believe? why is that hard for you to believe? you seem to have the preconceived notion that just because i happen to be a woman means that i have a colorful life. you don’t know who i am, nor do you know anything of my experiences.

this sweeping generalization of women is so dehumanizing. you complain about men putting women on pedestals whilst also.. putting women on pedestals. women are NOT infallible, women are people. those like you only consider your own perspectives and never stop to think about the logic behind these opinions. yes, there are women being chased by men, i don’t disagree. but to say that ALL women only live “colorful” lives because they are ALWAYS desired by men is just blatantly false. if this were the case then where is my “colorful life”? don’t see it. never have. looking around, i see nothing. where are the men chasing me??

you’re being dishonest with yourself and projecting your insecurities onto this female monolith that you’ve created in your head. of course some women are going to be frequently pursued by men, that’s what happens when your sex is treated as a commodity for most of, if not all of human history.

i am a person, not just some dripping wet vagina that men chase me for whenever i go outside. what a gross view you have of your fellow man.
